doc: Point-in-time tendency construction. half_life_games: exponential recency decay per game played. prior_games: last season's per-game average enters as this many pseudo-games, multiplied by new_coach_prior_factor when the head coach changed (NFL: the schedule's coach at game time; CFB: the cfbfastR head-coach table). league_prior_weight: weight of last season's league totals in the league reference, against the current season's own totals. Shrinkage constants k are measured on the training seasons only (research/params_<sport>.json) and are not edited by hand.
